Definition: to balance, i.e. measure out (by weight or dimension); figuratively, arrange, equalize, through the idea of levelling (ment. estimate, test)
BiblicalUsage: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes, but the Lord weigheth the spirits. A man says, behold, we knew it not, but He that pondereth the heart considers it, and Isaiah asks, who has measured the waters in the hollow of His hand, and weighed the mountains in scales? The word is to balance, to weigh out: God weighing hearts, and weighing mountains, in the same scales.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the weighing is both comfort and warning: my ways look clean to me, and God weighs the spirit behind them, and I hold that the same hand that weighed the mountains knows my heart exactly, and still invites me to come.
